feature_title: Add two new modules to the calc package that share no file: calc/stats.py with mean(values) returning the arithmetic mean (raise ValueError('empty') on an empty list) tested in tests/test_stats.py, and calc/text.py with slugify(s) lowercasing and replacing runs of non-alphanumerics with a single hyphen, tested in tests/test_text.py. Do NOT modify calc/__init__.py or any existing file; import the new functions by module path (from calc.stats import mean; from calc.text import slugify). The two are independent: plan them as two tasks with no dependency between them. Verify each with: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-aztechead-Projects-loop-spec/aa3a1338-0fde-4f0c-a27e-945117d04f37/scratchpad/venv/bin/python -m pytest -q <its test module>
warnings: slugify() only collapses runs of non-alphanumeric characters to a single hyphen; it does not strip a leading or trailing hyphen produced when the input starts or ends with a separator (e.g. slugify("Hello, World!") -> "hello-world-"). Neither test covers this case, so it's unverified behavior rather than a stated requirement violation.
